belongs_to: Text "This way of writing numbers is called the decimal system since it is based on the number 10" - the extended place value strip
description: A row of 10 adjacent boxes with black outlines, left to right: 1,00,000 | 10,000 | 1000 | 100 | 10 | 1 | 1/10 | 1/100 | 1/1000 | 1/10,000 (the last four as fractions). Above the row: 9 brown curved arrows each pointing LEFT to the neighbouring box on the left, each labelled "x 10" above (the labels over the four fraction boxes are in smaller type). Below the row: 9 brown curved arrows each pointing RIGHT, each labelled "÷ 10" below (smaller type over the fraction boxes).
